title: Admin dashboard: the console becomes a live dashboard
notes: The Admin console is now a dashboard: nav tabs to Participation, League News, and Audit log; at-a-glance cards for sheets, full picks, group total points, group average per week, subs used, and audit tripwire
Tap any member for their card: pick link with Copy, one-tap email pick-link reminder, per-member auto-picks (Off / Random / Smart), test flag, and deactivate with a confirm step
Per-member auto-picks replace the global method card: existing members keep the method they were running under; new members start Off until the admin sets them
Deactivated members are hidden from standings and the ticker, get no reminders, and can't pick or sub; history stays in the record and reactivation restores them
The dashboard refreshes every 10 seconds — cards, members, and activity update in place without reloading
Add member moves to a + button popup (name + test flag); scoring config moves to a popup carrying the recalculates-all-weeks warning

title: Admin console links to the audit log
notes: The Admin console now links to the Audit log alongside Participation and League News, so the audit view is one click away instead of a typed URL
The audit page itself links back to the Admin console, Participation, and League News

title: Unified audit system: every point movement has a cause
notes: New append-only audit log records every point-affecting event with its cause: picks, locks, subs, re-picks, feed observations, corrections, and feed switches. The log starts with this release and grows forward — no scoring computation changed
Dashboard gains a 'Why my score changed' section under MY PICKS: your own pick and stat movements in plain language, newest first, refreshed with the 60-second poll

Tap any pick row on the dashboard for its lock receipt — picked-at, locked-at, source (You or AUTO), and sub history. A standalone Pick history page (linked from MY PICKS) archives every week the same way

New Corrections feed lists every correction that moved a scored total, newest first, with a YOUR PICKS badge when it touches your lineup. Tackle corrections appear here even though they never hit the ticker

New How scoring works page: the scoring table, lock rules, and corrections policy, linked from the dashboard. The admin audit view shows the full log with week/kind/member filters, plus a tripwire that surfaces any score write since the log began with no recorded cause

title: CPU Smart learns from its own calls
notes: Every Smart decision now goes into a learning ledger with its predicted edge, and once its week closes the actual net is settled against it — live subs graded like the recaps grade yours, re-picks by full-week points gained vs standing pat

After each closed week the margin auto-tunes from the cumulative record: if Smart's predicted edges keep running ahead of actual nets, the margin rises and Smart demands more evidence before acting; if it keeps underpromising, the margin falls. Moves are capped at 0.25 per week inside a 0.5–2.0 band, and tuning starts after 6 judged calls
Watch it on the admin participation page, under Live substitutions. Forced inactive/bye moves don't count as judgments — only calls Smart chose to make

title: CPU Smart can re-pick before lockout
notes: Smart now has full pre-kickoff freedom: any pick whose game hasn't started can move. An inactive or bye pick always moves to the best available unstarted player; an active pick moves only when another available player's Adj beats its own by a full point or more
Re-picks are free and unlimited like members' pre-kickoff edits, and they can cross kickoff windows — the 1.0-point margin is what keeps Smart from churning on noise. CPU Random is untouched

title: CPU Smart manages its own lineup
notes: CPU Smart now makes its own substitution decisions in real games: while a game is live it compares each picked player's projected remaining points with the best same-window replacement and swaps when the replacement leads by a full point or more

Same member rules: 2 subs a week, same kickoff window, both games live, no re-entry, and the benched player keeps banked points — Smart's swaps show up in the ticker, window recaps, and the admin Live substitutions section just like yours
Before kickoff, a Smart pick confirmed inactive gets a free edit to the best same-window player instead of burning a sub; CPU Random is untouched

title: Published reports now get correction blocks
notes: When a big-play stat drops after a window's report is out (an overturned fumble, a corrected sack), the live poller records it and the report gains a timestamped Correction block with the old → new numbers — the original post is never rewritten
A red CORRECTION item scrolls in the ticker linking to the amended post until the next window's report goes out; tackle-only adjustments keep flowing into totals silently

title: Window reports now grade your substitutions
notes: Each window recap gains a Substitutions section: every swap in that window with what the replacement scored since entering, what the benched player scored after, and a Paid off / Wash / Backfired verdict on the net
Once a window's report is out, that window's SUB notifications leave the ticker — the report is the record now, and later windows' subs keep scrolling until their report goes out

title: Substitutions now headline the ticker
notes: Every completed substitution scrolls through the ticker with a SUB tag — who subbed, who went out, who came in, and the game clock — right alongside the window headline and the rest of the news
The ticker refresh picks new subs up automatically, so they appear within a few minutes of the swap

title: Scoring popups now respect substitutions too
notes: The YOUR PICK badge on live scoring popups follows the same rule as the scoring summary: a subbed-out player's later plays no longer badge as yours, and a replacement's plays badge from the moment he enters
Replacements' big plays now pop up league-wide as well — before this, only original picks ever appeared

title: Scoring summary shows only the points you actually got
notes: The scoring summary under MY PICKS now counts each player's time in your lineup: a subbed-out player's later plays no longer show up, and a replacement's plays from before he entered don't either
What you see in the summary now adds up to the points on your dashboard

title: MY PICKS rows back to a single line
notes: The SUB button now sits on the pick row itself, next to the points, instead of on a second line underneath — each player takes exactly the same height as when you first make your picks
Subbed-out players show a compact OUT tag; the swap detail (who came in, when, points banked) stays in the history line under the header

title: League News: recaps you can reply to
notes: NEW: League News (in the top nav) — every set of games gets its own recap post: top performers, who scored, and the week leaderboard at that moment
The ticker headline now links straight to its post — tap it to read the recap and join the conversation
Members can reply to any post; commissioner posts (rule changes, announcements) appear there too, marked in gold

title: Ticker headlines after every set of games
notes: NEW: the points ticker now carries a HEADLINE after the week scores — written automatically from the game data, no typing by anyone
It swaps after each set of games: Thursday night, Sunday 1 PM, Sunday 4 PM, Sunday night, and Monday night — naming the window's top player and what happened to the week's lead
After the last game it becomes the WEEK FINAL headline with the winner's score

title: Scoring summary on your dashboard
notes: NEW: a Scoring Summary card sits right under MY PICKS — every scoring play by your players this week, newest first, so you can review what the popups showed after they fade
Big plays (sacks, interceptions, forced fumbles and more) are listed one by one; tackles are grouped per player so the list stays readable
The card refreshes on its own while games are live, just like the rest of your dashboard

title: Player status chips — see who's ready and who's out
notes: Every player now carries a status chip wherever his name appears — the projections page, your dashboard picks, and the live page
Green Ready means he's active and available; IR, Inactive and PUP chips flag the players who can't score for you this week
Status comes from the official league roster feed and refreshes automatically, so a mid-week injury shows up on your own lineup too

title: Substitution engagement report for the commissioner
notes: The admin participation report now tracks the Week 7 substitution feature: who used their subs, when each swap happened, the points banked, what the replacement earned, and whether the swap gained points
It also follows the flow — how many members opened the sub screen and reached the confirm step — so we can see if the feature is easy to find and use

title: Week 7: live substitutions are here
notes: NEW: live substitutions — swap a player mid-game, up to 2 per week. The two dashes in your MY PICKS header on the dashboard are your subs, like timeouts: lit means one is still in your pocket
The replacement must come from the same kickoff window, and his points start counting from the moment he enters — the player you take out keeps the points he already banked
Tap SUB on any live pick, choose the replacement, and confirm (subs can't be undone, so the dashboard asks first)
Top Performers on the dashboard now shows the week's top 5

title: Test-member cards get the full standings treatment
notes: The Test members section now shows behind-leader, avg/week, and weekly movement (▲/▼) just like the main standings

Auto-filled picks are tagged AUTO on your MY PICKS rows and stay editable until that player kicks off; subs work the same as always
